name: dypol-creator-console
description: DYPOL Creator Console — dual-engine AI YouTube automation dashboard (DYPOL LABS)

scripts.preflight: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const need=['index.html','wrangler.toml','functions/api/health.js','schema.sql','assets/js/app.js'];const miss=need.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f));if(miss.length){console.error('Preflight FAILED — missing (are you in console/?):',miss.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('Preflight OK — console/ is complete; safe to deploy this directory.')"
scripts.deploy: npm run preflight && wrangler pages deploy .
